translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tiancong, when our army took Yongping, Guangyuan surrendered with his troops; he was assigned to the Plain Blue Banner, made Meile Ejen, and given court dress, saddle, and horse.

sentences.zh: 五年，上复伐明，圍大凌河，光遠從，招城南台降，得百總一、男婦五十餘，即畀光遠育焉。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the sovereign again attacked Ming and besieged Dalinghe; Guangyuan followed; he induced the surrender of the southern platform outside the wall, obtaining one company commander and more than fifty men and women, who were entrusted to Guangyuan to foster.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Taizong again attacked Ming and besieged Dalinghe; Guangyuan went with him, induced the southern platform to surrender, and took one company commander and more than fifty men and women, whom he was entrusted to care for.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，光遠疏言：「六部既設，當建內閣，選清正練達二三臣為總裁，日黎明入閣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixth year Guangyuan memorialized: "Since the Six Ministries have been established, a Grand Secretariat should be built, and two or three upright, experienced ministers chosen as chiefs of secretaries, entering the Secretariat at dawn each day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixth year Guangyuan memorialized: "Now that the Six Ministries exist, a Grand Secretariat should be established, with two or three upright and seasoned ministers chosen as chiefs to enter the Secretariat each day at dawn.

sentences.zh: 八家固山、六部承政，有事詣閣集議，請上指揮。」

translations.literal: The gushan of the Eight Houses and the ministers of the Six Ministries, when business arises, should go to the Secretariat to assemble and consult, and request the sovereign's command."
translations.idiomatic: The gushan of the Eight Houses and the ministers of the Six Ministries, when business arises, should meet in the Secretariat and seek Taizong's direction."

sentences.zh: 並議置六科，立八道言官。

translations.literal: He also proposed establishing the Six Offices of Scrutiny and creating censor posts for eight circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed establishing the Six Offices of Scrutiny and appointing censors for eight circuits.

sentences.zh: 翌日再疏，申言六科職掌。

translations.literal: The next day he memorialized again, elaborating on the duties of the Six Offices.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he memorialized again, setting out the duties of the Six Offices.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，烏真超哈昂邦章京佟養性及光遠合疏言：「上及諸貝勒豢漢官恩厚，臣等叨冒首領。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, Tong Yangxing, Angbang Zhangjing of the Ujencooha, and Guangyuan jointly memorialized: "The sovereign and the princes nourish Han officials with thick favor; we, your subjects, presumptuously head the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year Tong Yangxing, Angbang Zhangjing of the Ujencooha, and Guangyuan jointly memorialized: "Taizong and the princes have shown Han officials great favor; we, your subjects, presumptuously lead the ranks.

sentences.zh: 上有命，敢不竭心力。

translations.literal: When the sovereign gives a command, we dare not withhold our utmost effort.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong gives a command, we dare not withhold our full effort.

sentences.zh: 臣等有罪，聽諸臣彈劾。

translations.literal: If we, your subjects, are guilty, let the other officials impeach us.
translations.idiomatic: If we are guilty, let the other officials impeach us.

sentences.zh: 諸漢官如或抗令欺公，誑言誤事，諉避偷安，玩法科斂，臣等當彈劾，不敢避忌。

translations.literal: If any Han official disobeys orders and deceives the public, speaks falsehoods and ruins affairs, shirks and seeks ease, or treats the law lightly and extorts levies, we shall impeach them without avoiding anyone.
translations.idiomatic: If any Han official disobeys orders, deceives the public, speaks falsehoods and ruins affairs, shirks duty for ease, or treats the law lightly and extorts levies, we shall impeach him without fear or favor.

sentences.zh: 惟慮諸漢官茹怨，以蜚語中臣等，臣等得罪，雖死不知其故。

translations.literal: We only fear that Han officials will harbor resentment and use slander to strike at us; if we are punished, though we die we shall not know the reason.
translations.idiomatic: We only fear that Han officials will harbor resentment and use slander against us; if we are punished, we may die without knowing why.

sentences.zh: 乞上及諸貝勒鑒臣等意，今後有過失，即時處分；

translations.literal: We beg the sovereign and the princes to discern our intent: hereafter, if there are faults, punish them at once;
translations.idiomatic: We beg Taizong and the princes to discern our intent: hereafter, if we err, punish us at once;

sentences.zh: 有讒言，即時質問：俾僉邪不得行其險慝。」

translations.literal: if there is slander, question it at once, so the wicked may not carry out their treachery."
translations.idiomatic: if there is slander, question it at once, so the wicked cannot work their malice."

sentences.zh: 三月，光遠疏陳整飭軍政：省戎器，視牧馬，習砲，治砲車，節火藥，謹城守，制火箭，建藏砲儲藥之局，贍鑄砲造藥之役，厚養砲兵，凡十事。

translations.literal: In the third month Guangyuan memorialized on tightening military administration: ten items—economize weapons, inspect horse pasturage, drill with cannon, repair gun carriages, economize gunpowder, strictly defend cities, make rockets, establish bureaus to store cannon and medicines, supply the labor of casting cannon and making powder, and generously maintain gunners.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Guangyuan memorialized on tightening military administration in ten points: economize weapons, inspect horse pasturage, drill with cannon, repair gun carriages, conserve gunpowder, strengthen city defense, make rockets, establish bureaus for storing cannon and powder, supply the labor of casting guns and making powder, and generously maintain gunners.

sentences.zh: 七月，上命舊隸滿洲戶下漢人十丁授棉甲一，得千五百八十人，命光遠等統之，分補舊甲喇缺額。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the sovereign ordered that for every ten Han men formerly under Manchu households, one cotton armor be granted, yielding 1,580 men; Guangyuan and others were ordered to command them and fill old jalan vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Taizong ordered that for every ten Han men formerly registered under Manchu households, one cotton armor be issued, yielding 1,580 men; Guangyuan and others were ordered to command them and fill vacancies in the old jalan.

sentences.zh: 時孔有德、耿仲明來降，克旅順。

translations.literal: At this time Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming came over in surrender, and Lüshun was taken.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Kong Youde and Geng Zhongming surrendered, and Lüshun was taken.

sentences.zh: 光遠言：「有德等初來，登萊、旅順並各島兵艦隨至江口不敢歸，畏明法也。

translations.literal: Guangyuan said: "When Youde and the others first arrived, the warships of Deng-Lai, Lüshun, and the various island posts followed to the river mouth but dared not return for fear of Ming law.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan said: "When Youde and the others first came over, the warships of Deng-Lai, Lüshun, and the island posts followed to the river mouth but dared not return for fear of Ming law.

sentences.zh: 今旅順既失，江口兵艦必退保登萊。

translations.literal: Now that Lüshun has fallen, the warships at the river mouth will surely withdraw to hold Deng-Lai.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Lüshun has fallen, the warships at the river mouth will surely fall back to defend Deng-Lai.

sentences.zh: 宜急遣水師逐彼舟後，乘風而西。

translations.literal: We should urgently dispatch a naval force to follow their boats, riding the wind westward.
translations.idiomatic: We should urgently send a naval force to follow their ships, riding the wind westward.

sentences.zh: 上親帥師取山海，進攻北京，不半載大事可定。」

translations.literal: The sovereign should personally lead the army to take Shanhai Pass, advance on Beijing, and within half a year the great matter can be settled."
translations.idiomatic: Taizong should personally lead the army to take Shanhai Pass, advance on Beijing, and within half a year the great enterprise can be settled."

sentences.zh: 十月，授一等總兵官。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was granted first-rank commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was made first-rank commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，疏請出師：「一自薊東入，一自八里鋪趨山海關，內外夾攻，先取其水關，則山海關易下也。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year he memorialized requesting a campaign: "One column should enter from east of Ji; one should press on Shanhaiguan from Balipu; with inner and outer pincers, take the water gate first, and Shanhaiguan will then be easy to fall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year he memorialized requesting a campaign: "One force should enter from east of Ji, another press on Shanhaiguan from Balipu; with inner and outer pincers, take the water gate first, and Shanhaiguan will then fall easily.

sentences.zh: 既克山海關，還取祖大壽，整旅而西，進攻北京，塞衝要，阻運道，不數月必有內變。

translations.literal: Once Shanhaiguan is taken, return to take Zu Dashou, array the troops and march west, attack Beijing, block the strategic points, and cut the supply routes—in a few months there will surely be internal upheaval.
translations.idiomatic: Once Shanhaiguan is taken, return to take Zu Dashou, regroup and march west, attack Beijing, block the strategic passes, and cut the supply routes—in a few months there will surely be internal upheaval.

sentences.zh: 但乞上於出師之日，戒諭將士，毋殺，毋淫，毋掠貨財，毋焚廬舍。

translations.literal: We only beg that on the day the army marches out, the sovereign admonish the officers and soldiers: do not kill, do not commit licentious acts, do not plunder goods, do not burn dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: We only beg that on the day the army marches out, Taizong admonish the officers and soldiers: do not kill, do not commit licentious acts, do not plunder goods, do not burn dwellings.

sentences.zh: 四方聞之，皆引領而歸上矣。」

translations.literal: When all quarters hear this, they will all stretch their necks to submit to the sovereign."
translations.idiomatic: When all quarters hear this, they will all turn to Taizong in submission."

sentences.zh: 四月，改一等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month his title was changed to first-rank Angbang Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month his title was changed to first-rank Angbang Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，甄別轄治漢人各官，以各堡戶丁增減行賞罰，丁減初額三之一者削世職為民。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year officials governing Han people were appraised; rewards and punishments were meted according to the increase or decrease of household registers in each fortress; those whose population fell by one third of the original figure had their hereditary office stripped and were reduced to commoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year officials governing Han people were appraised; rewards and punishments followed the rise or fall of household registers in each fortress, and those whose population fell by one third of the original count were stripped of hereditary office and reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 光遠疏言：「各官功次不等，皆蒙敕賜世襲，得之至艱。

translations.literal: Guangyuan memorialized: "The officers' merits differ, yet all received imperial grants of hereditary rank—obtaining it was extremely hard.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan memorialized: "The officers' merits differ, yet all received imperial grants of hereditary rank—gaining it was exceedingly hard.

sentences.zh: 今以養人不如法，皆罷為民，眾情驚懼。

translations.literal: Now, because they did not rear their people properly, all are dismissed to commoner status, and public sentiment is alarmed and fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Now, because they did not maintain their people properly, all are reduced to commoner status, and public sentiment is alarmed and fearful.

sentences.zh: 乞恩從重議罰，而毋遽奪世職；

translations.literal: We beg grace to impose heavier penalties after deliberation, but not hurriedly to strip hereditary offices;
translations.idiomatic: We beg grace to impose heavier penalties after deliberation, but not to strip hereditary offices at once;

sentences.zh: 令戴罪視事，使功不如使過。

translations.literal: Let them serve their posts while bearing guilt, so that correcting faults may serve better than doing merit.
translations.idiomatic: Let them serve their posts while bearing guilt, so that redeeming faults may serve better than doing merit.

sentences.zh: 臣為王法持平，敢昧死以請。」

translations.literal: Your subject, upholding the royal law in fairness, dares risk death to make this request."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject, upholding the royal law in fairness, dares risk death to make this request."

sentences.zh: 梅勒額真張存仁亦以為言，上從之。

translations.literal: Meile Ejen Zhang Cunren also spoke similarly, and the sovereign followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Meile Ejen Zhang Cunren spoke similarly, and Taizong agreed.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，諸臣勸進，漢將列孔有德、耿仲明、尚可喜、石廷柱及光遠，凡五人。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year, when the officials urged accession, the Han generals listed were Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, Shi Tingzhu, and Guangyuan—five in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the tenth year, when the officials urged accession, the Han generals named were Kong Youde, Geng Zhongming, Shang Kexi, Shi Tingzhu, and Guangyuan—five in all.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年十二月，從伐朝鮮，克平壤、江華島。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Chongde he followed the campaign against Korea and took Pyongyang and Ganghwa Island.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Chongde he joined the campaign against Korea and took Pyongyang and Ganghwa Island.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，分烏​​真超哈為兩翼，置固山額真二。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year the Ujencooha was divided into two wings and two Gushan Ejen were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year the Ujencooha was split into two wings and two Gushan Ejen were appointed.

sentences.zh: 以廷柱轄左翼，光遠轄右翼。

translations.literal: Tingzhu commanded the Left Wing and Guangyuan the Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhu commanded the Left Wing and Guangyuan the Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 三年，上伐明，攻錦州，烏真超哈運火器為前驅。

translations.literal: In the third year the sovereign attacked Ming and besieged Jinzhou; the Ujencooha transported firearms as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Taizong attacked Ming and besieged Jinzhou; the Ujencooha transported firearms as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 尋與有德以火器克台五，復與廷柱克李雲屯、柏士屯、郭家堡、開州、井家堡，俘七百有三，得牲畜稱是。

translations.literal: Soon, together with Youde, he took five platforms with firearms; then with Tingzhu he took Li Yuntun, Baishitun, Guojia Fort, Kaizhou, and Jingjia Fort, capturing 703 persons and livestock in matching numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he and Youde took five platforms with firearms; then with Tingzhu he took Li Yuntun, Baishitun, Guojia Fort, Kaizhou, and Jingjia Fort, capturing 703 persons and a comparable number of livestock.

sentences.zh: 光遠率甲喇額真郎紹貞圍攻錦州城旁台，敵遁，不追擊，上詰之，光遠妄辯，當奪職，上命罰鍰。

translations.literal: Guangyuan, leading Jalan Ejen Lang Shaozhen, besieged a platform beside Jinzhou city; the enemy fled and he did not pursue; the sovereign questioned him; Guangyuan defended himself falsely and should have been stripped of office—the sovereign ordered a fine instead.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan, leading Jalan Ejen Lang Shaozhen, besieged a platform beside Jinzhou; the enemy fled and he did not pursue; Taizong questioned him; Guangyuan answered falsely and should have been dismissed—Taizong ordered a fine instead.

sentences.zh: 四年，上复伐明，光遠以所部克松山西南隅台，降其將楊文顯，攻城不克。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the sovereign again attacked Ming; Guangyuan with his command took the southwest-corner platform of Songshan and caused its general Yang Wenxian to surrender; he could not take the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Taizong again attacked Ming; Guangyuan with his command took the southwest platform of Songshan and induced its general Yang Wenxian to surrender, but could not take the city.

sentences.zh: 語詳石廷柱傳。

translations.literal: The account is detailed in Shi Tingzhu's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The account is given in detail in Shi Tingzhu's biography.

sentences.zh: 師還，數其罪而罷之；

translations.literal: When the army returned, his offenses were counted and he was dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, his offenses were counted and he was dismissed;

sentences.zh: 又以庇所部參將季世昌鑄砲子不中程，論死，上特宥之。

translations.literal: Also for shielding his subordinate regimental commander Ji Shichang, whose cast cannonballs did not meet specification—a capital offense—the sovereign specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: Also for shielding his subordinate regimental commander Ji Shichang, whose cast cannonballs failed to meet specification—a capital offense—Taizong specially pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 六月，析烏真超哈為八旗，置固山額真四，復起光遠為正黃、鑲黃兩旗固山額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Ujencooha was split into Eight Banners, four Gushan Ejen appointed, and Guangyuan was restored as Gushan Ejen of the Plain Yellow and Bordered Yellow Banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Ujencooha was reorganized into Eight Banners with four Gushan Ejen appointed, and Guangyuan was restored as Gushan Ejen of the Plain Yellow and Bordered Yellow Banners.

sentences.zh: 漢軍旗制定，光遠隸鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: When the Han Banner system was fixed, Guangyuan was assigned to the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han Banner system was fixed, Guangyuan was assigned to the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，以老病乞休。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, citing old age and illness, he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shunzhi he asked to retire on account of old age and illness.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，卒，諡誠順。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi he died and was given the posthumous name Chengshun.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Kangxi he died and was given the posthumous name Chengshun.

sentences.zh: 以弟之子思文襲爵。

translations.literal: His younger brother's son Siwen inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother's son Siwen inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 恩詔進三等伯。

translations.literal: By grace edict he was posthumously raised to third-rank Baron.
translations.idiomatic: By grace edict he was posthumously raised to third-rank Baron.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等子。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign the fief was fixed at first-rank viscount.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign the fief was fixed at first-rank viscount.

sentences.zh: 光輝，光遠弟。

translations.literal: Guanghui was Guangyuan's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghui was Guangyuan's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 明武舉。

translations.literal: He had been a military licentiate under Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Under Ming he had been a military licentiate.

sentences.zh: 與其兄光先從光遠來降。

translations.literal: Together with his elder brother Guangxian he followed Guangyuan in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Together with his elder brother Guangxian he followed Guangyuan in surrender.

sentences.zh: 天聰七年，授光先二等參將，光輝游擊。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tiancong Guangxian was made second-rank regimental commander and Guanghui a guerrilla officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tiancong Guangxian was made second-rank regimental commander and Guanghui a guerrilla officer.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，任戶部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was made a ministry commissioner of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was made a ministry commissioner of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 以貸官商物不償，罷官，奪世職。

translations.literal: For lending government goods to merchants without repayment he was dismissed from office and stripped of his hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: For lending government goods to merchants without repayment he was dismissed from office and stripped of his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，漢軍旗制定，授鑲黃旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year, when the Han Banner system was fixed, he was made Meile Ejen of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year, when the Han Banner system was fixed, he was made Meile Ejen of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 六年，兼任吏部。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he concurrently held the Board of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he concurrently held the Board of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 七年，以從克杏山城，复世職。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, for following in the capture of Xingshan city, his hereditary rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, for joining in the capture of Xingshan, his hereditary rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 師已克錦州，命光輝從固山額真孟喬芳詣錦州監鑄砲。

translations.literal: After the army had taken Jinzhou, Guanghui was ordered to go with Gushan Ejen Meng Qiaofang to Jinzhou to supervise cannon casting.
translations.idiomatic: After the army had taken Jinzhou, Guanghui was ordered to go with Gushan Ejen Meng Qiaofang to Jinzhou to supervise the casting of cannon.

sentences.zh: 八年，以從克中後所、前屯衛二城，進一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, for following in the capture of Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei, two cities, he was promoted to first-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, for joining in the capture of Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei, he was raised to first-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 世祖入關定鼎，參政改侍郎，光輝仍貳吏部。

translations.literal: When Shizu entered the pass and established the dynasty, commissioner posts were changed to vice ministers, and Guanghui remained second-in-command at the Board of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu entered the pass and established the dynasty, commissioner posts became vice ministers, and Guanghui remained second-in-command at the Board of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，考滿，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, upon completion of his performance review, he was granted tušan lahafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, when his term review was complete, he was granted tušan lahafan.

sentences.zh: 五年，從征南大將軍譚泰討江西叛將金聲桓，聲桓既誅，譚泰將承製授光輝江西提督，光輝辭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the southern expedition grand general Tan Tai in suppressing the Jiangxi rebel general Jin Shenghuan; after Shenghuan had been executed, Tan Tai was about to receive the imperial order to appoint Guanghui military governor of Jiangxi, and Guanghui declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed the southern expedition grand general Tan Tai against the Jiangxi rebel Jin Shenghuan; after Shenghuan was executed, Tan Tai was to receive the imperial mandate appointing Guanghui military governor of Jiangxi, but Guanghui refused.

sentences.zh: 既，譚泰欲以都察院理事官紀國先為都司，國先亦辭。

translations.literal: Thereupon Tan Tai wished to make the Censorate commissioner Ji Guoxian a brigade commander, and Guoxian also declined.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai then proposed making Censorate commissioner Ji Guoxian a brigade commander; Guoxian declined as well.

sentences.zh: 譚泰劾國先，辭連光輝，吏議從重比，上命罷光輝梅勒額真、侍郎，降世職為拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: Tan Tai impeached Guoxian, and his plea implicated Guanghui; officials recommended the heaviest penalty; the sovereign ordered Guanghui dismissed from Meile Ejen and vice minister, his hereditary rank reduced to baitalaburu hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai impeached Guoxian, implicating Guanghui in the process; officials urged the severest punishment; the sovereign stripped Guanghui of Meile Ejen and vice-ministerial rank and reduced his hereditary office to baitalaburu hafan.

sentences.zh: 七年，復任梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was again appointed Meile Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was restored as Meile Ejen.

sentences.zh: 八年，上命追錄光輝軍功，屢遇恩詔，累進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the sovereign ordered Guanghui's military merits recorded retroactively; at repeated grace edicts he rose cumulatively to third-rank ashan-i janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the sovereign ordered Guanghui's past military service recorded; through successive grace edicts he rose to third-rank ashan-i janggin.

sentences.zh: 五月，授戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was made vice minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was appointed vice minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十月，命以兵部尚書、右副都御史總督直隸、山東、河南三行省。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was ordered to serve as minister of the Board of War and right vice censor-in-chief, governor-general of the three provinces of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was ordered to serve as minister of the Board of War and right vice censor-in-chief, governing Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十年九月，膠州總兵海時行叛，為暴萊、沂間，光輝帥師討之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the tenth year, Jiaozhou garrison commander Hai Shixing rebelled and wreaked havoc between Lai and Yi; Guanghui led troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the tenth year Jiaozhou garrison commander Hai Shixing rebelled and ravaged the country between Lai and Yi; Guanghui led troops against him.

sentences.zh: 時行走宿遷，師從之，复走永城。

translations.literal: Shixing fled to Suqian and the army pursued; he fled again to Yongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Shixing fled to Suqian with the army in pursuit, then fled again to Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 光輝會漕運總督沈文奎帥師自靈壁向永城，戰洪河集西，大破之，縛時行以歸。

translations.literal: Guanghui joined Grand Canal transport governor Shen Wenkui in leading troops from Lingbi toward Yongcheng; they fought west of Hongheji, utterly defeated the rebels, bound Shixing, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghui joined Grand Canal transport governor Shen Wenkui and led troops from Lingbi toward Yongcheng; west of Hongheji they routed the enemy, captured Shixing bound, and returned.

sentences.zh: 以功加級，任子。

translations.literal: For merit he received a promotion in rank and an office for his son.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was promoted in rank and his son was granted an office.

sentences.zh: 十一年，甄別諸督撫，加太子少保，以老病乞休。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, in an appraisal of governors and grand coordinators, he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; citing age and illness he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when governors and grand coordinators were appraised, he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; citing age and illness he asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月，卒，諡忠靖。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twelfth year he died; posthumous title Zhongjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twelfth year he died and was posthumously titled Zhongjing.

sentences.zh: 光先，順治間遇恩詔，亦授三等阿思哈尼哈番，官山西左布政使。

translations.literal: Guangxian, during Shunzhi at a grace edict, was also granted third-rank ashan-i janggin and served as left provincial administration commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi, Guangxian received third-rank ashan-i janggin at a grace edict and served as left provincial administration commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 李思忠，字葵陽，鐵嶺人。

translations.literal: Li Sizhong, styled Kuiyang, was a native of Tieling.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sizhong, styled Kuiyang, was from Tieling.

sentences.zh: 父如梴，明遼東總兵官寧遠伯成梁族子也，仕明為太原同知，罷歸居撫順。

translations.literal: His father Ruchan was a clansman of Ming's Liaodong regional commander and Ningyuan Earl Cheng Liang; he served Ming as Tongzhi of Taiyuan, was dismissed, returned home, and lived at Fushun.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ruchan was a kinsman of Ming's Liaodong regional commander and Ningyuan Earl Cheng Liang; he had served Ming as Tongzhi of Taiyuan, was dismissed, and settled at Fushun.

sentences.zh: 太祖天命三年，始用兵於明，克撫順，得思忠，如梴徙還鐵嶺。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianming, when Taizu first took up arms against Ming, he took Fushun and obtained Sizhong; Ruchan moved back to Tieling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianming, when Taizu first campaigned against Ming, he took Fushun and gained Sizhong; Ruchan moved back to Tieling.

sentences.zh: 明年，師下鐵嶺，如梴及弟如梓子一忠、存忠死之。

translations.literal: The next year the army descended on Tieling; Ruchan and his younger brother Ruzi's sons Yizhong and Cunzhong died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the army took Tieling; Ruchan and his younger brother Ruzi's sons Yizhong and Cunzhong were killed.

sentences.zh: 六年，定遼陽，敕思忠收其族人，俾復故業，即授牛錄額真，予世職備禦。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Liao yang was secured; Sizhong was ordered to gather his clansmen and restore them to their former livelihoods; he was immediately made Niru Ejen and granted the hereditary office of frontier defense commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Liaoyang was secured, Sizhong was ordered to gather his clansmen and restore their livelihoods; he was immediately made Niru Ejen and granted the hereditary rank of frontier defense commander.

sentences.zh: 尋以獲諜，進游擊。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, for capturing a spy, he was promoted to guerrilla commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, for capturing a spy, he was promoted to guerrilla commander.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，太宗自將伐明，取永平等四城。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong Taizong personally led a campaign against Ming and took Yongping and three other cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiancong Taizong personally campaigned against Ming and took Yongping and three other cities.

sentences.zh: 師還，貝勒阿敏護諸將分守，察哈喇以蒙古兵守遵化，思忠及甲喇額真英固勒岱等為之佐。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Beile Amin escorted the generals to divide and garrison; Chahala garrisoned Zunhua with Mongol troops, and Sizhong and Jalan Ejen Yingguledai and others assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, Beile Amin saw the generals to their divided garrisons; Chahala held Zunhua with Mongol troops, assisted by Sizhong, Jalan Ejen Yingguledai, and others.

sentences.zh: 既而明將謝尚忠等來攻，思忠與戰，敵三進三卻。

translations.literal: Before long Ming generals Xie Shangzhong and others came to attack; Sizhong fought them, and the enemy advanced three times and retreated three times.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ming generals Xie Shangzhong and others attacked; Sizhong fought them off as the enemy advanced three times and fell back three times.

sentences.zh: 阿敏議棄四城東還，檄察哈喇合軍出塞。

translations.literal: Amin proposed abandoning the four cities and returning east, and ordered Chahala to unite the armies and withdraw beyond the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Amin proposed abandoning the four cities and withdrawing east, and ordered Chahala to combine the armies and leave the frontier.

sentences.zh: 時尚忠攻遵化正急，發火箭焚我軍火器，我軍方恇擾，思忠戒無輕動，徐結陣出城，挾降吏四人以俱，身為殿，出塞無一亡失。

translations.literal: At that time Shangzhong was pressing the attack on Zunhua fiercely, firing rockets that burned our army's firearms; our troops were just becoming alarmed and unsettled; Sizhong warned against rash movement, slowly formed ranks and left the city, taking four surrendered officials with him, himself serving as rearguard; beyond the frontier not one was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Shangzhong was then pressing hard on Zunhua, firing rockets that set our firearms ablaze; as our troops wavered, Sizhong forbade any rash move, drew up ranks and withdrew from the city with four surrendered officials, himself covering the rear; not a man was lost beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 師還，上譴阿敏等，以思忠力戰，貸勿罪。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the sovereign reprimanded Amin and others; because Sizhong had fought hard, he was pardoned without punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, the sovereign rebuked Amin and the others; Sizhong, having fought hard, was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 五年，從固山額真楞格里等伐明，攻南海島，未至，遇明兵茨榆坨，俘十一人，得舟五。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Gushan Ejen Lenggeri and others in campaigning against Ming to attack Nanhaidao; before arriving they met Ming troops at Ciyutuo, captured eleven men, and obtained five boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Gushan Ejen Lenggeri and others against Ming to attack Nanhaidao; before reaching it they met Ming troops at Ciyutuo, took eleven prisoners, and seized five boats.

sentences.zh: 明兵爭舟，思忠與戰，砲傷額，勿卻，卒敗明兵，進二等參將。

translations.literal: Ming soldiers fought for the boats; Sizhong battled them, was wounded in the forehead by cannon fire but did not retreat, finally defeated the Ming troops, and was promoted to second-rank regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: Ming troops fought for the boats; Sizhong engaged them, was struck in the forehead by cannon fire but held his ground, finally routed the Ming force, and was promoted to second-rank regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 九年，察漢官所領城堡戶口盈耗，思忠轄沙河堡郎寨，增丁百十有三，上嘉賞，賜狐裘一襲，進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the ninth year household registers in fortresses under Han officials were examined for increase or decrease; Sizhong's jurisdiction of Shahe Fort Langzhai gained one hundred and thirteen adult males; the sovereign commended him, granted a fox-fur coat, and promoted him to third-rank Meile Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the population of fortresses under Han officials was audited; Sizhong's jurisdiction at Shahe Fort Langzhai gained one hundred thirteen adult males; the sovereign commended him, granted a fox-fur coat, and promoted him to third-rank Meile Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 尋命駐蓋州。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was ordered to garrison Gaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to garrison Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，命修遼陽諸城，思忠疏言：「蓋州處邊，士卒任防守，餘丁僅足以耕。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, when repairs to the cities of Liaoyang were ordered, Sizhong memorialized: "Gaizhou lies on the frontier; the soldiers are charged with defense, and the remaining men are barely enough to farm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongde, when the cities of Liaoyang were ordered repaired, Sizhong memorialized: "Gaizhou is a frontier post; soldiers are assigned to defense, and the remaining men barely suffice for farming.

sentences.zh: 今棄農就役，工窳而農亦廢。

translations.literal: Now if farming is abandoned for corvée labor, the work will be shoddy and farming will also be ruined.
translations.idiomatic: If they leave the fields for corvée now, the work will be poor and farming will collapse as well.

sentences.zh: 請俟諸城工竟，庀役造磚從事。」

translations.literal: I request that we wait until work on the other cities is finished, then organize labor and make bricks for the task."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that we wait until the other cities' work is done, then organize labor and manufacture bricks for the project."

sentences.zh: 上允其請。

translations.literal: The sovereign granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign approved his request.

sentences.zh: 七年，漢軍旗制定，隸正黃旗。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the Han Banner system was fixed, he was assigned to the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when the Han Banner system was fixed, he was assigned to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從豫親王多鐸徇陝西，破潼關；

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Yu Dorgon in pacifying Shaanxi and broke through Tong Pass;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Yu Dorgon in pacifying Shaanxi and broke through Tong Pass;

sentences.zh: 下江南，克揚州，撫定江北州縣凡十。

translations.literal: descended on Jiangnan, took Yangzhou, and pacified ten prefectures and counties north of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: then descended on Jiangnan, took Yangzhou, and pacified ten prefectures and counties north of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，命以梅勒額真戍西安。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year he was ordered to garrison Xi'an as Meile Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year he was ordered to garrison Xi'an as Meile Ejen.

sentences.zh: 三月，擢陝西提督。

translations.literal: In the third month he was promoted to military governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was promoted to military governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 恩詔，累進一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: At grace edicts he rose cumulatively to first-rank ashan-i janggin with tušan lahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Through grace edicts he rose to first-rank ashan-i janggin with tušan lahafan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he retired.

sentences.zh: 十四年七月，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourteenth year he died.

sentences.zh: 思忠子五，第三子顯祖襲爵，世祖賜名塞白理，授二等侍衛、甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Sizhong had five sons; his third son Xianzu inherited the title; Shizu bestowed the name Saibaili and appointed him second-rank bodyguard and Jalan Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhong had five sons; his third son Xianzu inherited the title; Shizu gave him the name Saibaili and appointed him second-rank bodyguard and Jalan Ejen.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，授隨徵江南左路總兵官，遷廣東水師提督，改浙江提督。

translations.literal: In the early Kangxi reign he was made commander of the left route army following the southern campaign in Jiangnan, transferred to naval commander of Guangdong, and then changed to military governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he was made commander of the left route army in the Jiangnan campaign, then transferred to naval commander of Guangdong and later to military governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 耿精忠叛，自福建侵浙江，塞白理疏請分兵援台州，防寧波。

translations.literal: When Geng Jingzhong rebelled and invaded Zhejiang from Fujian, Saibaili memorialized requesting division of troops to relieve Taizhou and guard Ningbo.
translations.idiomatic: When Geng Jingzhong rebelled and invaded Zhejiang from Fujian, Saibaili memorialized asking that troops be divided to relieve Taizhou and guard Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 尋從貝子傅喇塔擊走精忠將曾養性。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he followed Beizi Fuleta in driving off Jingzhong's general Zeng Yangxing.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Beizi Fuleta in driving off Jingzhong's general Zeng Yangxing.

sentences.zh: 十四年九月，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourteenth year he died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourteenth year he died in camp.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封三等男。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign the fief was fixed as third-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign the fief was fixed as third-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 廕祖，思忠次子。

translations.literal: Yinzu was Sizhong's second son.
translations.idiomatic: Yinzu was Sizhong's second son.

sentences.zh: 事世祖，自廕生授戶部員外郎，三遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Serving Shizu, from a yin appointment he was made department director of the Board of Revenue, and was transferred three times to reach vice minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Serving Shizu, he entered through a yin appointment as department director of the Board of Revenue and was transferred three times to vice minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 順治十一年，直隸災，命與尚書巴哈納等治賑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Shunzhi, when Zhili suffered disaster, he was ordered with Minister Bahana and others to manage relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Shunzhi, when Zhili was stricken by disaster, he was ordered with Minister Bahana and others to manage relief.

sentences.zh: 尋授兵部尚書，右副都御史，總督直隸、山東、河南三行省。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was made minister of the Board of War, right vice censor-in-chief, and governor-general of Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made minister of the Board of War and right vice censor-in-chief, governing Zhili, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 疏請蠲被災諸州縣秋糧，招流民還故里，當隨地安集，以時予賑，毋使道殕。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting remission of autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken prefectures and counties, calling back displaced people to their native places, settling them locally as circumstances allowed, granting relief in season, and not allowing corpses on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to remit autumn grain tax in stricken prefectures and counties, recall displaced people to their homes, settle them locally, grant timely relief, and prevent corpses from littering the roads.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「直隸濱海北塘、澗河、黑洋諸地，宜分兵駐守。」

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Along the Zhili coast at Beitang, Jianhe, Heiyang, and other places, troops should be divided and stationed on garrison duty."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Along the Zhili coast at Beitang, Jianhe, Heiyang, and other points, troops should be posted in divided garrisons."

sentences.zh: 時議禁海船，魚鹽米麥不能轉輸，請官為編號，譏其出入，則商民皆便。

translations.literal: At the time sea vessels were banned by policy, so fish, salt, rice, and wheat could not be transported; he requested that officials register and inspect their coming and going, which would benefit merchants and commoners alike.
translations.idiomatic: Sea vessels were then banned, blocking transport of fish, salt, rice, and wheat; he asked that officials register and inspect them on entry and exit, which would serve merchants and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 並下部議行。

translations.literal: Both proposals were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Both proposals were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，疏發河南管河道方大猷貪惏狀，上切責河道總督楊方興失劾，奪大猷官，鞫治論死。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year he memorialized exposing the greed of Fang Dayou, Henan canal commissioner; the sovereign sharply rebuked Grand Canal governor Yang Fangxing for failing to impeach him, stripped Dayou of office, tried him, and sentenced him to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year he exposed the corruption of Henan canal commissioner Fang Dayou; the sovereign sharply rebuked Grand Canal governor Yang Fangxing for failing to impeach him, stripped Dayou of office, tried him, and sentenced him to death.

sentences.zh: 有高鼎者，據五台山為亂，出三岔口擾真定，廕祖遣井陘道陳安國諭降，悉散其黨。

translations.literal: There was one Gao Ding who seized Wutai Mountain in rebellion, came out through Sanchakou to harass Zhending; Yinzu sent Jingxing circuit intendant Chen Anguo to persuade him to surrender, and entirely dispersed his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ding seized Wutai Mountain in rebellion and raided Zhending through Sanchakou; Yinzu sent Jingxing circuit intendant Chen Anguo to accept his surrender and fully dispersed his band.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「太行天下險，三岔居其衝，林密山深，藏奸甚易。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Taihang range is the greatest barrier under Heaven; Sanchakou lies on its vital pass; the forests are dense and the mountains deep, making it very easy to hide wrongdoers.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The Taihang range is the greatest barrier in the realm; Sanchakou sits on its vital pass; dense forest and deep mountains make hiding criminals all too easy.

sentences.zh: 自鼎降，其黨散在民間，雖戍以兵，視營壘為傳舍。

translations.literal: Since Ding surrendered, his followers have scattered among the people; though garrisoned with troops, they treat the camps as inns.
translations.idiomatic: Since Ding surrendered, his followers have scattered among the people; though troops are posted there, the camps serve them only as inns.

sentences.zh: 當置游擊一，定額兵六百，耑司守禦。」

translations.literal: A guerrilla commander should be posted with a fixed quota of six hundred troops, exclusively charged with frontier defense."
translations.idiomatic: A guerrilla commander should be posted with a fixed quota of six hundred troops devoted solely to frontier defense."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The sovereign followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign approved.

sentences.zh: 是歲廕祖年才二十有九，會湖南北用兵，上察廕祖才，加太子太保，移督湖廣。

translations.literal: That year Yinzu was only twenty-nine; as Hunan and Hubei were at war, the sovereign saw Yinzu's talent, made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and transferred him to governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yinzu was only twenty-nine; with Hunan and Hubei at war, the sovereign recognized his ability, made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and transferred him to governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 師方徇貴州，故李自成諸將郝永忠、袁宗第、劉體純、李來亨輩挾十餘萬人降於明，踞鄖、襄間，擾餉道。

translations.literal: The army was just then pacifying Guizhou; former generals of Li Zicheng—Hao Yongzhong, Yuan Zongdi, Liu Tichun, Li Laiheng, and others—with more than one hundred thousand men had surrendered to Ming and held the region between Yun and Xiang, harassing supply routes.
translations.idiomatic: The army was then pacifying Guizhou; former Li Zicheng generals Hao Yongzhong, Yuan Zongdi, Liu Tichun, Li Laiheng, and others, with more than one hundred thousand men, had surrendered to Ming and held the Yun-Xiang region, raiding supply lines.

sentences.zh: 廕祖請選襄陽水師及均、黃、漢陽諸營兵二千人戍穀城，地扼上游；

translations.literal: Yinzu requested selection of two thousand troops from the Xiangyang naval force and the garrisons of Jun, Huang, and Hanyang to garrison Gucheng, a place controlling the upper reaches;
translations.idiomatic: Yinzu asked that two thousand troops be drawn from the Xiangyang naval force and the Jun, Huang, and Hanyang garrisons to garrison Gucheng, which commands the upper reaches;

sentences.zh: 選武昌洞庭營兵千人戍九谿，斷通蜀道。

translations.literal: and selection of one thousand troops from the Wuchang Dongting garrison to garrison Jiuxi, cutting off the route to Shu.
translations.idiomatic: and one thousand troops from the Wuchang Dongting garrison to garrison Jiuxi, blocking the route into Shu.

sentences.zh: 十五年，漢陽、天門、潛江、沔陽諸郡縣水災，上命廕祖治賑，民賴以得拯。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Hanyang, Tianmen, Qianjiang, Mianyang, and other prefectures and counties suffered flood disaster; the sovereign ordered Yinzu to manage relief, and the people relied on this to be saved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year floods struck Hanyang, Tianmen, Qianjiang, Mianyang, and other prefectures and counties; the sovereign ordered Yinzu to manage relief, and the people were saved through his efforts.

sentences.zh: 十六年，經略大學士洪承疇疏請發湖北提鎮標兵六千人戍雲南，廕祖以承疇已發湖廣兵萬三千五百有奇，湖南新收降人數万，鄖、襄間流賊未殄，留兵不宜復發，請敕承疇就滇中召募，下部議行。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Grand Secretary and frontier commissioner Hong Chengchou memorialized requesting dispatch of six thousand troops from Hubei's provincial and garrison banners to garrison Yunnan; Yinzu replied that Chengchou had already sent more than thirteen thousand five hundred Huguang troops, that Hunan had newly received tens of thousands of surrendered men, and that bandits between Yun and Xiang had not yet been exterminated; retaining troops made further dispatch inadvisable; he requested that Chengchou be ordered to recruit within Yunnan; the proposal was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year frontier commissioner Hong Chengchou asked to send six thousand Hubei banner troops to Yunnan; Yinzu replied that Chengchou had already dispatched more than thirteen thousand five hundred Huguang troops, that Hunan had just absorbed tens of thousands of surrenders, and that bandits in the Yun-Xiang region were not yet destroyed; further dispatch was inadvisable, and Chengchou should recruit within Yunnan; the proposal was referred to the ministries.

sentences.zh: 复疏議：「討永忠等，請敕四川總督李國英帥師駐重慶，扼巫峽，阻達州；

translations.literal: He again memorialized with a plan: "To suppress Yongzhong and the others, I request that Sichuan governor-general Li Guoying be ordered to lead troops stationed at Chongqing, holding Wuxia Gorge and blocking Dazhou;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again with a plan: "To suppress Yongzhong and the others, Sichuan governor-general Li Guoying should be ordered to lead troops at Chongqing, holding Wuxia Gorge and blocking Dazhou;

sentences.zh: 西安將軍富喀禪帥師趨興安；

translations.literal: Xi'an general Fukacan should lead troops toward Xing'an;
translations.idiomatic: Xi'an general Fukacan should lead troops toward Xing'an;

sentences.zh: 河南協剿兵詣襄陽合軍。

translations.literal: Henan coordinated suppression troops should proceed to Xiangyang to unite the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Henan coordinated suppression troops should join the main force at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 臣督諸軍分出彝陵、襄陽、鄖陽，三道深入，期一舉滅賊。」

translations.literal: Your subject will direct the armies in three columns from Yiling, Xiangyang, and Yunyang, advancing deep, expecting to destroy the bandits in one stroke."
translations.idiomatic: I will direct the armies in three columns from Yiling, Xiangyang, and Yunyang, advancing deep to destroy the bandits in one stroke."

sentences.zh: 疏既上，會鄭成功犯江南，詔將軍明安達哩將荊州駐防兵赴援，部議緩師期。

translations.literal: After the memorial was submitted, Zheng Chenggong invaded Jiangnan; the sovereign ordered General Mingadali to lead the Jingzhou garrison troops to the relief; the ministries deliberated and postponed the campaign schedule.
translations.idiomatic: After the memorial was submitted, Zheng Chenggong invaded Jiangnan; the sovereign ordered General Mingadali to lead Jingzhou garrison troops to the relief; the ministries postponed the campaign schedule.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以疾乞罷。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, citing illness he requested dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he asked to be dismissed on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kangxi he died.

sentences.zh: 祀直隸、山東、河南、湖廣名宦。

translations.literal: He was enshrined in the temples of eminent officials of Zhili, Shandong, Henan, and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in the temples of eminent officials of Zhili, Shandong, Henan, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 鈵，廕祖子。

translations.literal: Bin was Yinzu's son.
translations.idiomatic: Bin was Yinzu's son.

sentences.zh: 事聖祖，自佐領授兵部員外郎。

translations.literal: Serving Shengzhu, from company captain he was made department director of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Serving Shengzhu, he rose from company captain to department director of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以參將從征吳三桂，再遷御史。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, as regimental commander he joined the campaign against Wu Sangui, and was promoted twice to censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, as regimental commander he joined the campaign against Wu Sangui and was promoted twice to censor.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，湖廣夏逢龍為亂，上授鈵湖北按察使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Xia Fenglong of Huguang raised rebellion; the sovereign appointed Bin provincial surveillance commissioner of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Xia Fenglong rebelled in Huguang; the sovereign appointed Bin provincial surveillance commissioner of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 累擢兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to vice minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to vice minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，命與左都御史於成龍等督​​餉。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the sovereign personally campaigned against Galdan and ordered him with left censor-in-chief Yu Chenglong and others to supervise supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the sovereign personally campaigned against Galdan and ordered him, with left censor-in-chief Yu Chenglong and others, to supervise supplies.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，授山東巡撫，以疾辭，改授安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year he was made governor of Shandong; citing illness he declined, and was instead appointed governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he was made governor of Shandong; citing illness he declined and was instead appointed governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，疾未瘳，被彈事罷。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, his illness not yet recovered, he was impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year, still unrecovered from illness, he was impeached and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，山東飢，鈵請往助賑，卒於賑所。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, when Shandong suffered famine, Bin requested to go and assist in relief and died at the relief station.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, when Shandong suffered famine, Bin volunteered to assist in relief and died at the relief station.

sentences.zh: 金玉和，遼東人。

translations.literal: Jin Yuhe was a native of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Yuhe was from Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 仕明為開原千總。

translations.literal: He served Ming as a thousand-commander at Kaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Ming he served as a thousand-commander at Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 太祖克開原，玉和降，授甲喇額真，予世職三等副將。

translations.literal: When Taizu took Kaiyuan, Yuhe surrendered, was made Jalan Ejen, and granted the hereditary office of third-rank deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu took Kaiyuan, Yuhe surrendered, was made Jalan Ejen, and granted the hereditary rank of third-rank deputy general.

sentences.zh: 漢軍旗制定，隸正黃旗。

translations.literal: When the Han Banner system was fixed, he was assigned to the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han Banner system was fixed, he was assigned to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，擢禮部承政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong he was promoted to chief minister of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tiancong he was promoted to chief minister of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 六年，上閱兵，玉和與額駙佟養性等率所轄烏真超哈擐甲列陣試砲，上賚以鞍馬。

translations.literal: In the sixth year at a troop review, Yuhe with the emperor's son-in-law Tong Yangxing and others led their Ujencooha in armor and drawn formation to test cannon; the sovereign rewarded them with saddles and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year at a troop review, Yuhe and the emperor's son-in-law Tong Yangxing and others led their Ujencooha in armor and drawn ranks to test cannon; the sovereign rewarded them with saddles and horses.

sentences.zh: 八年，考績，進二等副將。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, upon merit review, he was promoted to second-rank deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, upon merit review, he was promoted to second-rank deputy general.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，坐與吏部參政李延庚互舉子弟，罷官，降世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, for jointly recommending their sons and nephews with Board of Civil Appointments commissioner Li Yangeng, he was dismissed from office and his hereditary rank reduced to third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde, for mutually recommending their sons and nephews with Board of Civil Appointments commissioner Li Yangeng, he was dismissed and his hereditary rank reduced to third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 二年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明皮島，以水師戰不利，玉和不赴援，論死，上特宥之，但削世職。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige in campaigning against Ming at Pidao; the naval force fought unfavorably and Yuhe did not go to their aid; he was sentenced to death, but the sovereign specially pardoned him, only stripping his hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige against Ming at Pidao; the naval force fared poorly and Yuhe failed to reinforce it; he was sentenced to death, but the sovereign specially pardoned him, stripping only his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 四年，复授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was again appointed Jalan Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was again appointed Jalan Ejen.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍明錦州，屢敗敵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he joined the siege of Ming's Jinzhou and repeatedly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the siege of Ming's Jinzhou and repeatedly defeated the enemy.

sentences.zh: 敵夜攻壕塹，擊卻之，斬級五十。

translations.literal: The enemy attacked the trenches by night; he repulsed them and took fifty heads.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy attacked the trenches by night; he drove them back and took fifty heads.

sentences.zh: 七年，錦州下，並克塔山，予世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Jinzhou fell and Tashan was also taken; he was granted the hereditary office of Niru Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Jinzhou fell and Tashan was also taken; he was granted the hereditary rank of Niru Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 八年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗伐明寧遠，與王國光同克前屯衛、中後所二城。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in campaigning against Ming at Ningyuan, and together with Wang Guoguang took Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo, two cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang against Ming at Ningyuan and, together with Wang Guoguang, took Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，擢工部參政。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he was promoted to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Shunzhi reign, he was promoted to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 敘寧遠功，進三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: For merit at Ningyuan, he was advanced to third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In recognition of his service at Ningyuan, he was raised to third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 既入關，遷梅勒額真。

translations.literal: After entering the Pass, he was transferred to Meiren Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: After the Qing armies crossed the Shanhaiguan Pass, he was promoted to Meiren Ejen.

sentences.zh: 從軍河南，署懷慶總兵官。

translations.literal: He accompanied the army to Henan and served as acting Regional Commander of Huaqing.
translations.idiomatic: He marched with the army into Henan and was appointed acting Regional Commander of Huaqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時李自成竄陝西，餘黨掠河南，犯濟源縣城，玉和帥師往援，至則城已陷，夜半遇賊，力戰，中流矢，沒於陣。

translations.literal: At that time Li Zicheng had fled to Shaanxi, but remnant bands plundered Henan and attacked Jiyuan county seat; Yuhe led troops to the rescue, and when he arrived the city had already fallen; at midnight he encountered the bandits, fought fiercely, was struck by an arrow, and perished on the battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng had by then fled to Shaanxi, but his remnants were still raiding Henan and attacked the county seat of Jiyuan. Yuhe led his forces to their relief, but by the time he arrived the city had already fallen. At midnight he met the enemy in battle, fought until an arrow struck him, and died in combat.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫羅綉錦疏報得玉和遺骸於柏鄉西，請賜卹，進二等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Henan Governor Luo Xiujin memorialized reporting that Yuhe's remains were recovered west of Baixiang and requested posthumous favors; [Yuhe] was advanced to second-rank Meiren Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: The Governor of Henan, Luo Xiujin, reported in a memorial that Yuhe's body had been recovered west of Baixiang and petitioned for posthumous honors; Yuhe was posthumously promoted to second-rank Meiren Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封二等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, [the title] was fixed as second-class Baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign, the hereditary rank was standardized as second-class Baron.

sentences.zh: 金維城，玉和子也。

translations.literal: Jin Weicheng was Yuhe's son.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Weicheng was the son of Yuhe.

sentences.zh: 崇德初，師攻錦州，維城以甲喇額真奉命與梅勒額真金礪督餉，屢從伐明有功。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongde, when the army attacked Jinzhou, Weicheng, as Jalan Ejen, was ordered to supervise provisions together with Meiren Ejen Jin Li; he repeatedly followed campaigns against Ming and had merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Chongde reign, when the Qing besieged Jinzhou, Weicheng—then serving as Jalan Ejen—was ordered to supervise logistics alongside Meiren Ejen Jin Li. He took part in repeated campaigns against the Ming and distinguished himself repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 克中後所、前屯衛二城，維城亦在行間。

translations.literal: When Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei, two cities, were captured, Weicheng was also among the marching ranks.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhonghousuo and Qiantunwei fell, Weicheng was among the troops in the field.

sentences.zh: 累官正白旗漢軍梅勒額真，兼兵部參政，世職至牛錄章京。

translations.literal: Through successive offices he rose to Meiren Ejen of the Plain White Banner Han Army, concurrently serving as Vice Minister of the Ministry of War; the hereditary office descended to Niru Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to Meiren Ejen of the Plain White Banner Han Army while also serving as Vice Minister of the Ministry of War; the hereditary rank descended to Niru Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 從入關，改兵部侍郎，兼梅勒額真如故。

translations.literal: Following entry into the Pass, he was changed to Vice Minister of the Ministry of War, retaining Meiren Ejen as before.
translations.idiomatic: After the Qing entered China proper, he was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of War while retaining his post as Meiren Ejen.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，改拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi, he was reappointed Tatabure Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 4, his hereditary rank was changed to Tatabure Hafan.

sentences.zh: 考績，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Upon merit evaluation, Toosara Hafan was added.
translations.idiomatic: After a performance review, he was granted the additional rank of Toosara Hafan.

sentences.zh: 復從定湖廣，同克武岡、沅州、靖州，進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He again followed in pacifying Huguang, jointly capturing Wugang, Yuanzhou, and Jingzhou, and was advanced to first-rank Adaha Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign to pacify Huguang, helping capture Wugang, Yuanzhou, and Jingzhou, and was promoted to first-rank Adaha Hafan.

sentences.zh: 調正黃旗漢軍梅勒額真。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Meiren Ejen of the Plain Yellow Banner Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Meiren Ejen of the Plain Yellow Banner Han Army.

sentences.zh: 十年，坐總兵任珍行賕罷官，降世職為三等。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he was dismissed from office on account of Regional Commander Ren Zhen's bribery, and his hereditary office was reduced to third class.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 10, he was dismissed from office after being implicated in bribery by Regional Commander Ren Zhen, and his hereditary rank was reduced to third class.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Shunzhi year 15.

sentences.zh: 子世礪，康熙間，以佐領從平南大將軍賚塔徵福建，敗敵江東橋。

translations.literal: His son Shili, during the Kangxi reign, as Company Commander followed Commander-in-Chief of Southern Pacification Saiha to campaign in Fujian and defeated the enemy at Jiangdong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shili, during the Kangxi reign, served as a Company Commander under Commander-in-Chief Saiha on the Fujian campaign and routed the enemy at Jiangdong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 鄭成功將劉國軒攻漳州，世礪戰死，予世職拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When Zheng Chenggong's general Liu Guoxuan attacked Zhangzhou, Shili died in battle; he was granted the hereditary office of Toosara Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Guoxuan, a general under Zheng Chenggong, attacked Zhangzhou, Shili was killed in battle; he was posthumously granted the hereditary rank of Toosara Hafan.

sentences.zh: 太祖克開原，玉和與同官王一屏、戴集賓、白奇策，守堡百總戴一位降；

translations.literal: When the Taizu captured Kaiyuan, Yuhe together with colleagues Wang Yiping, Dai Jibin, and Bai Qice, and fort-garrison platoon leader Dai Yiwei, surrendered;
translations.idiomatic: After the Taizu took Kaiyuan, Yuhe, along with his fellow officers Wang Yiping, Dai Jibin, and Bai Qice, and the fort-garrison platoon leader Dai Yiwei, surrendered;

sentences.zh: 下廣寧，游擊孫得功，守備張士彥、黃進、石廷柱，千總郎紹貞、陸國志、石天柱降；

translations.literal: Upon taking Guangning, Mobile Corps Commander Sun Degong, Garrison Commanders Zhang Shiyan, Huang Jin, and Shi Tingzhu, and Platoon Captains Lang Shaozhen, Lu Guozhi, and Shi Tianzhu surrendered;
translations.idiomatic: When Guangning fell, Mobile Corps Commander Sun Degong, Garrison Commanders Zhang Shiyan, Huang Jin, and Shi Tingzhu, and Platoon Captains Lang Shaozhen, Lu Guozhi, and Shi Tianzhu all surrendered;

sentences.zh: 收遼河諸城堡，參將劉世勳，游擊羅萬言、何世延、閻印，都司金礪、劉式章、李維龍、王有功、陳尚智，備禦硃世勳、黃宗魯，中軍王志高，守堡閔雲龍、俞鴻漸、鄭登、崔進忠、李詩、徐鎮靜、鄭維翰、臧國祚、周元勳、王國泰，各以所守城堡來降。

translations.literal: When the Liao River fortresses were secured, Brigadier General Liu Shixun; Mobile Corps Commanders Luo Wanyan, He Shiyan, and Yan Yin; Assistant Commanders Jin Li, Liu Shizhang, Li Weilong, Wang Yougong, and Chen Shangzhi; Defense Officers Zhu Shixun and Huang Zonglu; Headquarters Officer Wang Zhigao; and fort-garrison officers Min Yunlong, Yu Hongjian, Zheng Deng, Cui Jinzhong, Li Shi, Xu Zhenjing, Zheng Weihan, Zang Guozuo, Zhou Yuanxun, and Wang Guotai each came to surrender with the forts they guarded.
translations.idiomatic: As the Liao River fortresses were brought under control, Brigadier General Liu Shixun; Mobile Corps Commanders Luo Wanyan, He Shiyan, and Yan Yin; Assistant Commanders Jin Li, Liu Shizhang, Li Weilong, Wang Yougong, and Chen Shangzhi; Defense Officers Zhu Shixun and Huang Zonglu; Headquarters Officer Wang Zhigao; and fort-garrison officers Min Yunlong, Yu Hongjian, Zheng Deng, Cui Jinzhong, Li Shi, Xu Zhenjing, Zheng Weihan, Zang Guozuo, Zhou Yuanxun, and Wang Guotai each surrendered with the fortresses they had held.

sentences.zh: 玉和、一屏、得​​功、士彥、廷柱、礪皆以有功授世職。

translations.literal: Yuhe, Yiping, Degong, Shiyan, Tingzhu, and Li were all granted hereditary offices for their merit.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhe, Yiping, Degong, Shiyan, Tingzhu, and Li were all granted hereditary ranks in recognition of their service.

sentences.zh: 廷柱自有傳。

translations.literal: Tingzhu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tingzhu has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 王一屏，先世本滿洲，姓完顏氏。

translations.literal: Wang Yiping's ancestors were originally Manchu, surname Wanyan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yiping's ancestors were originally Manchu, of the Wanyan clan.

sentences.zh: 初降，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Upon first surrendering, he was appointed Niru Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: When he first surrendered, he was appointed Niru Ejen.

sentences.zh: 漢軍旗制定，隸正紅旗。

translations.literal: When the Han Army Banners were established, he was assigned to the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han Army Banners were organized, he was assigned to the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，授世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, he was granted the hereditary office of third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong year 8, he was granted the hereditary rank of third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 子國光，以牛錄額真兼戶部理事官，襲職。

translations.literal: His son Guoguang, as Niru Ejen concurrently serving as Managing Official of the Ministry of Revenue, inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guoguang inherited the rank while serving as Niru Ejen and concurrently as a managing official of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 擢正紅旗漢軍梅勒額真，兼戶部參政。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Meiren Ejen of the Plain Red Banner Han Army, concurrently serving as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Meiren Ejen of the Plain Red Banner Han Army while also serving as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗伐明，克前屯衛、中後所二城，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, following Prince Zheng Jirhalang in attacking Ming, he captured Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo, two cities, and was advanced to second-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined Prince Zheng Jirhalang's campaign against the Ming, helped capture Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo, and was raised to second-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，改戶部侍郎，兼梅勒額真如故。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he was changed to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, retaining Meiren Ejen as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi, he was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue while retaining his post as Meiren Ejen.

sentences.zh: 從定西大將軍和洛輝禦寇西安。

translations.literal: He followed Western Pacification Commander-in-Chief Helohei in defending against bandits at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Western Pacification Commander-in-Chief Helohei in repelling rebels at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 考滿，進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Upon completing merit evaluation, he was advanced to first-rank Adaha Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: After a successful performance review, he was promoted to first-rank Adaha Hafan.

sentences.zh: 遷本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Gushan Ejen of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Gushan Ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 六年，從英親王阿濟格討叛將薑瓖，克左衛、朔州、汾州、太谷四城。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, following Prince Ying Ajige in suppressing rebel general Jiang Xiang, he captured Zuowei, Shuozhou, Fenzhou, and Taigu, four cities.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 6, he joined Prince Ying Ajige in suppressing the rebel Jiang Xiang and helped capture Zuowei, Shuozhou, Fenzhou, and Taigu.

sentences.zh: 敘功，遇恩詔，累進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: Merit was recorded; upon a grace edict, he was cumulatively advanced to first-rank Ashan Janggin Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: His achievements were formally recorded, and under a grace edict he was cumulatively raised to first-rank Ashan Janggin Hafan.

sentences.zh: 十年，從定遠大將軍、貝勒屯齊徵湖廣，擊敗明將李定國、孫可望。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, following Commander-in-Chief of Distant Pacification, Beile Tunqi, campaigning in Huguang, he defeated Ming generals Li Dingguo and Sun Kewang.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 10, he joined Beile Tunqi, Commander-in-Chief of Distant Pacification, on the Huguang campaign and defeated the Ming generals Li Dingguo and Sun Kewang.

sentences.zh: 十二年，從寧海大將軍伊勒德援浙江，擊敗明將鄭成功、張名振。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, following Eastern Sea Pacification Commander Irgen Gioro Iletu to relieve Zhejiang, he defeated Ming generals Zheng Chenggong and Zhang Mingzhen.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 12, he joined Eastern Sea Pacification Commander Iletu in relieving Zhejiang and defeated the Ming generals Zheng Chenggong and Zhang Mingzhen.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月，授兩廣總督，諭獎其才品，賜蟒服、鞍馬，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirteenth year, he was appointed Governor-General of Liangguang; an edict commended his talent and character, and he was granted a python robe and saddle horse and given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi year 13, he was appointed Governor-General of Liangguang. The throne commended his ability and character in an edict, granted him a python robe and saddle horse, and added the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以疾解任。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he resigned due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 15, he resigned on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 十八年，聖祖即位，授鎮海將軍，帥師鎮潮州。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the Sage Emperor ascended the throne, he was appointed Military Governor of Zhenhai and led troops garrisoning Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 18, when the Kangxi Emperor ascended the throne, he was appointed Military Governor of Zhenhai and commanded troops garrisoning Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，與平南王尚可喜會師討碣石叛將蘇利，師至海豐，偵破敵伏，迳燈籠山。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, he joined forces with Prince of Pingnan Shang Kexi to suppress Jieshi rebel Su Li; the army reached Haifeng, scouts detected and broke an enemy ambush, and they proceeded directly to Denglong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 3, he joined Prince of Pingnan Shang Kexi to suppress the Jieshi rebel Su Li. When the army reached Haifeng, scouts uncovered and broke an enemy ambush, and the force pressed straight on to Denglong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 蘇利乘我軍未成列，以萬餘人搏戰，我軍左右夾擊，賊潰​​遁。

translations.literal: Su Li took advantage when our army had not yet formed ranks and joined battle with more than ten thousand men; our army attacked from left and right, and the bandits broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Su Li struck while the Qing forces were still forming ranks, charging with more than ten thousand men. The Qing army attacked from both flanks, and the rebels broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 薄碣石衛城，環攻拔之，斬蘇利及所部陳英、李慧等，遂殲其餘黨。

translations.literal: Approaching Jieshi garrison city, they surrounded and captured it, beheaded Su Li and his subordinates Chen Ying, Li Hui, and others, and then annihilated the remaining followers.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed on to Jieshi garrison city, surrounded it, and took it by storm. Su Li and his officers Chen Ying and Li Hui were beheaded, and the remaining rebels were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 五年，還京，仍任本旗​​都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he returned to the capital and still served as Banner General of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 5, he returned to the capital and resumed his post as Banner General of his banner.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he died; his posthumous title was Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi year 9 and was given the posthumous title Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子永譽，字孝揚，襲爵。

translations.literal: His son Yongyu, courtesy name Xiaoyang, inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yongyu, courtesy name Xiaoyang, inherited the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 十二年，授河南提督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was appointed Provincial Military Commander of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 12, he was appointed Provincial Military Commander of Henan.

sentences.zh: 河北總兵蔡祿叛應吳三桂，內大臣阿密達帥師討之。

translations.literal: Hebei Regional Commander Cai Lu rebelled in support of Wu Sangui; Inner Minister Amidac led troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei Regional Commander Cai Lu rebelled in support of Wu Sangui, and Inner Minister Amidac led an army against him.

sentences.zh: 上命永譽如懷慶，拊循士卒，因請留駐鎮撫。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Yongyu to go to Huaqing to comfort the troops; he thereby requested to remain stationed for pacification.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Yongyu to Huaqing to reassure the troops, and he asked to remain there on garrison and pacification duty.

sentences.zh: 旋設安慶提督，以授永譽。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward the post of Provincial Military Commander of Anqing was established and given to Yongyu.
translations.idiomatic: The post of Provincial Military Commander of Anqing was then created and conferred on Yongyu.

sentences.zh: 耿精忠將宋標方自饒州犯徽州，十四年，永譽督兵駐建德，令參將傅爾學破標於餘幹，俘標，磔於市。

translations.literal: Geng Jingzhong's general Song Biaofang invaded Huizhou from Raozhou; in the fourteenth year Yongyu supervised troops stationed at Jiande, ordered Deputy Commander Fu Erxue to defeat Biao at Yugan, captured Biao, and executed him by dismemberment in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: When Geng Jingzhong's general Song Biaofang invaded Huizhou from Raozhou, Yongyu in Kangxi year 14 directed troops stationed at Jiande and ordered Deputy Commander Fu Erxue to defeat Song at Yugan. Song was captured and executed by dismemberment in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 尋移駐徽州。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he transferred his garrison to Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He soon moved his headquarters to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年，江西平。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Jiangxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi was pacified in Kangxi year 17.

sentences.zh: 改永譽江南提督，駐松江。

translations.literal: Yongyu was changed to Provincial Military Commander of Jiangnan, stationed at Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyu was reassigned as Provincial Military Commander of Jiangnan and stationed at Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 十九年，遷廣東將軍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, he was transferred to Military Governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 19, he was transferred to Military Governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二十年，疏言：「廣東瀕海，陸路兩鎮，請各以一營改練水師。」

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he memorialized: "Guangdong borders the sea and has two land garrisons; I request that one battalion from each be retrained as naval forces."
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 20 he memorialized: "Guangdong lies on the coast and maintains two land garrisons; I request that one battalion from each be converted and trained as naval forces."

sentences.zh: 二十二年，復請留滿洲兵四千駐防廣東省城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, he again requested that four thousand Manchu troops be retained to garrison the provincial capital of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 22, he again requested that four thousand Manchu troops be kept on garrison duty in the provincial capital of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 皆如所議行。

translations.literal: All were carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: All of these proposals were approved and implemented.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，授本旗都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, he was appointed Banner General of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 27, he was appointed Banner General of his banner.

sentences.zh: 二十三年三月，命定北將軍瓦岱帥師屯張家口，诇噶爾丹，以永譽與都統喀岱等參贊軍務。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-third year, Northern Pacification General Wadai was ordered to lead troops stationed at Zhangjiakou to reconnoiter Galdan; Yongyu, together with Banner General Kadai and others, was assigned to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Kangxi year 23, Northern Pacification General Wadai was ordered to encamp at Zhangjiakou and scout Galdan's movements; Yongyu, together with Banner General Kadai and others, was appointed to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，分漢軍為四營，永譽帥正黃、正紅二旗出中路，噶爾丹不戰遁。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, the Emperor personally campaigned against Galdan; the Han Army was divided into four camps, and Yongyu commanded the Plain Yellow and Plain Red Banners on the central route; Galdan fled without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 35, the Emperor led a personal campaign against Galdan. The Han Army was divided into four camps, and Yongyu commanded the Plain Yellow and Plain Red Banners on the central route; Galdan fled without giving battle.

sentences.zh: 永譽與平北將軍馬斯喀督兵追躡，偵噶爾丹行遠，乃還。
