translations.literal: Yongyu and Northern Pacification General Masike supervised troops in pursuit; scouts reported that Galdan had traveled far, and they then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyu and Northern Pacification General Masike led the pursuit, but when scouts reported that Galdan was already far away, they turned back.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，從上至寧夏，命督餉運，貯黃河西岸，聞噶爾丹竄死，罷，還。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, he followed the Emperor to Ningxia and was ordered to supervise grain transport stored on the west bank of the Yellow River; upon hearing that Galdan had fled and died, he was dismissed and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 36, he accompanied the Emperor to Ningxia and was ordered to supervise grain shipments stored on the west bank of the Yellow River. When word came that Galdan had fled and died, he was relieved of duty and returned.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi year 43.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年，命其族改隸滿洲正紅、鑲白二旗。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong, his clan was ordered to transfer to the Manchu Plain Red and Bordered White Banners.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 18, his clan was ordered to transfer to the Manchu Plain Red and Bordered White Banners.

sentences.zh: 孫得功，在明為廣寧巡撫王化貞中軍游擊，化貞倚得功為心膂。

translations.literal: Sun Degong, under the Ming, served as mobile corps commander to Guangning Grand Coordinator Wang Huabian; Huabian relied on Degong as right-hand man.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming, Sun Degong served as mobile corps commander to Guangning Grand Coordinator Wang Huabian, on whom Huabian relied as his right-hand man.

sentences.zh: 太祖圍西平堡，劉渠等赴援，令得功從。

translations.literal: When the Taizu besieged Xiping Fort, Liu Qu and others went to reinforce it, and Degong was ordered to follow.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu besieged Xiping Fort, Liu Qu and others marched to its relief, and Degong was ordered to accompany them.

sentences.zh: 渠等戰死，得功潛納款於太祖，還言師已薄城，城人驚潰。

translations.literal: Qu and the others died in battle; Degong secretly pledged allegiance to the Taizu, returned saying the army had already approached the city, and the city people panicked and broke.
translations.idiomatic: Qu and the others were killed in battle. Degong secretly submitted to the Taizu, then returned claiming that the Qing army was already at the walls, throwing the city into panic and rout.

sentences.zh: 化貞走入關，得功與進、紹貞、國誌等，率士民出城東三里望昌岡，具乘輿，設鼓樂，執旗張蓋，迎太祖入駐巡撫署，士民皆夾道俯伏呼萬歲。

translations.literal: Huabian fled into the Pass; Degong, together with Jin, Shaozhen, Guozhi, and others, led soldiers and civilians three li east of the city to Wangchang Ridge, prepared an imperial carriage, set out drums and music, bore banners and canopies, and welcomed the Taizu to take up residence in the grand coordinator's yamen; soldiers and civilians all lined the roads, prostrating themselves and shouting "Long live!"
translations.idiomatic: Huabian fled through the Pass into China proper. Degong, together with Jin, Shaozhen, Guozhi, and others, led soldiers and civilians three li east of the city to Wangchang Ridge, where they prepared an imperial carriage, arranged drums and music, and bore banners and canopies to welcome the Taizu into the grand coordinator's yamen. Soldiers and civilians lined the roads, prostrating themselves and shouting "Long live!"

sentences.zh: 時天命七年正月庚申，月之二十四日也。

translations.literal: It was the gengshen day of the first month of the seventh year of Tianming—the twenty-fourth day of the month.
translations.idiomatic: This took place on the gengshen day, the twenty-fourth day of the first month of the seventh year of Tianming.

sentences.zh: 上授得功游擊，隸鑲白旗，轄降眾，移駐義州。

translations.literal: The sovereign appointed Degong mobile corps commander, assigned him to the Bordered White Banner to govern surrendered troops, and moved his garrison to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu appointed Degong mobile corps commander, assigned him to the Bordered White Banner to command surrendered troops, and transferred his garrison to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 天聰六年十月，得功疏言：「上命修城，天寒土凍，徒勞民力而不能堅固，請俟春融。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year of Tiancong, Degong memorialized: "Your Majesty ordered wall repairs, but the weather is cold and the earth is frozen—this wastes the people's labor without producing solid work; I request waiting until the spring thaw.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Tiancong year 6, Degong memorialized: "Your Majesty ordered repairs to the city walls, but the weather is cold and the earth frozen; the work wastes the people's labor without yielding solid results. I request that it wait until the spring thaw.

sentences.zh: 又上發帑畀官兵市布製冬衣，官已足用，兵人給銀五錢六分，得布不足以為衣，乞恩使人得市布一二疋，官兵均霑上澤。」

translations.literal: Moreover, Your Majesty dispensed treasury funds for officers and soldiers to buy cloth for winter garments; the officers already have enough, but common soldiers were given five qian and six fen of silver—enough to buy cloth insufficient for a garment; I beg grace so that each man might buy one or two bolts of cloth, so officers and soldiers alike may share in Your Majesty's bounty."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Your Majesty dispensed treasury funds for officers and soldiers to buy cloth for winter clothing. The officers already have enough, but common soldiers received only five qian and six fen of silver—barely enough for cloth to make a garment. I beg that each man be allowed to buy one or two bolts of cloth, so officers and soldiers alike may share in Your Majesty's bounty."

sentences.zh: 七年四月，又疏言：「禁淡巴菰，令未能行。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year, he memorialized again: "The ban on tobacco cannot yet be enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year, he memorialized again: "The ban on tobacco cannot yet be enforced.

sentences.zh: 步兵皆用火器，尤宜申諭戒革。

translations.literal: Foot soldiers all use firearms; it is especially fitting to reiterate the prohibition and urge reform.
translations.idiomatic: Foot soldiers all use firearms, so it is especially important to reiterate the prohibition and press for reform.

sentences.zh: 上令民輸糧，因禁百穀不得入市，貧民無所得食，則宜任民便。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty ordered the people to deliver grain, and because all grain was barred from market, the poor had no food to obtain—this should rather be left to the people's convenience."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty ordered the people to deliver grain, and because all grain was barred from market sale, the poor had nothing to eat; this policy should rather be left to the people's convenience."

sentences.zh: 八年，追敘得功廣寧功，授三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Degong's merit at Guangning was retrospectively recorded, and he was granted third-rank Meiren Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Degong's service at Guangning was retrospectively recorded, and he was granted third-rank Meiren Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 旋卒，以其子孫有光襲。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he died, and his descendant Youguang inherited.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward, and his descendant Youguang inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 漢軍旗制定，改隸正白旗。

translations.literal: When the Han Army Banners were established, he was transferred to the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han Army Banners were organized, the family was reassigned to the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以從克前屯衛、中後所及順治間討姜瓖有功，並遇恩詔，進三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: For following in the capture of Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo and for merit suppressing Jiang Xiang during Shunzhi, and also upon a grace edict, he was advanced to third-rank Jinggin Janggin Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For joining in the capture of Qiantunwei and Zhonghousuo and for service against Jiang Xiang during the Shunzhi reign, and under a grace edict as well, he was raised to third-rank Jinggin Janggin Hafan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong, [the title] was fixed as first-class Baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign, the hereditary rank was standardized as first-class Baron.

sentences.zh: 得功次子思克，自有傳。

translations.literal: Degong's second son Sike has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Degong's second son, Sike, has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 張士彥，化貞中軍守備。

translations.literal: Zhang Shiyan was Huabian's garrison commander in the central army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shiyan served as garrison commander in Wang Huabian's central army.

sentences.zh: 太祖兵至，化貞走入關，士彥降。

translations.literal: When the Taizu's army arrived, Huabian fled into the Pass and Shiyan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu's army arrived, Huabian fled through the Pass into China proper, and Shiyan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 漢軍旗制定，隸正藍旗。

translations.literal: When the Han Army Banners were established, he was assigned to the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han Army Banners were organized, he was assigned to the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，與一屏同授三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, together with Yiping he was granted third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong year 8, he and Yiping were both granted third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 旋乞休。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: He soon requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 子朝璘，襲職。

translations.literal: His son Chaolin inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chaolin inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 崇德七年，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongde, he was appointed Niru Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year 7, he was appointed Niru Ejen.

sentences.zh: 從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，敗敵於膠州。

translations.literal: He followed Beile Abatai in attacking Ming and defeated the enemy at Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Beile Abatai's campaign against the Ming and defeated the enemy at Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，與國光同功，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, sharing merit with Guoguang, he was advanced to second-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, for the same achievements as Guoguang, he was raised to second-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部理事官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Managing Official of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a managing official of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，從豫親王多鐸下江南，克揚州、江陰，率兵戍蘇州，擊敗明將黃斐。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, following Prince Yu Duoduo south of the Yangtze, he captured Yangzhou and Jiangyin, led troops garrisoning Suzhou, and defeated Ming general Huang Fei.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 2, he followed Prince Yu Duoduo south of the Yangtze, helped capture Yangzhou and Jiangyin, garrisoned Suzhou with his troops, and defeated the Ming general Huang Fei.

sentences.zh: 四年，從恭順王孔有德等平湖南，破明將劉承胤於夕陽橋，克武岡；

translations.literal: In the fourth year, following Prince Gongshun Kong Youde and others in pacifying Hunan, he defeated Ming general Liu Chengyin at Xiyang Bridge and captured Wugang;
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 4, he joined Prince Gongshun Kong Youde and others in pacifying Hunan, routed the Ming general Liu Chengyin at Xiyang Bridge, and captured Wugang;

sentences.zh: 复破明將張先璧於黔陽，克沅州。

translations.literal: He again defeated Ming general Zhang Xianbi at Qianyang and captured Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: he again defeated the Ming general Zhang Xianbi at Qianyang and captured Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，從討姜瓖，復與國光同功。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, following in suppressing Jiang Xiang, again sharing merit with Guoguang.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 6, he joined the campaign against Jiang Xiang and again earned equal credit with Guoguang.

sentences.zh: 考滿，遇恩詔，進一等阿思哈尼哈番，授正藍旗漢軍梅勒額真。

translations.literal: Upon completion of his performance review, upon a grace edict he was advanced to first-rank Ashan-i Janggin Hafan and appointed Meile Ejen of the Plain Blue Banner Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: After his term review, a grace edict raised him to first-rank Ashan-i Janggin Hafan and appointed him Meile Ejen of the Plain Blue Banner Han Army.

sentences.zh: 十年，授都察院左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 10, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 13, he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 尋出為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was sent out as governor of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon posted as governor of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 江西當金聲桓亂後，民少田蕪，御史笪重光請蠲賦，下朝璘議。

translations.literal: Jiangxi, after Jin Shenghuan's rebellion, had a sparse population and overgrown fields; censor Da Chongguang requested remission of taxes, and the matter was referred to Chaolin for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin Shenghuan's rebellion in Jiangxi, the population was depleted and fields lay fallow; censor Da Chongguang petitioned for tax relief, and the case was sent to Chaolin for recommendation.

sentences.zh: 朝璘疏言：「田畝荒蕪，惟從容勸墾，則熟者恆熟，荒者不終荒。

translations.literal: Chaolin memorialized: "When fields lie waste, only by leisurely encouraging reclamation will what is fertile remain constantly fertile and what is waste not stay waste forever.
translations.idiomatic: Chaolin memorialized: "When farmland lies abandoned, only by patiently encouraging reclamation will fertile land stay fertile and wasteland not remain waste forever.

sentences.zh: 若急於徵賦，則始以荒為熟，漸至熟者仍荒，非足國恤民計也。

translations.literal: If one is eager to collect taxes, at first what is waste is treated as fertile, and gradually what is fertile becomes waste again—this is no way to enrich the state and relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: If taxes are pressed too hard, wasteland is first counted as cultivated land, and in time cultivated land turns to waste again—this serves neither the state nor the people.

sentences.zh: 南昌、瑞州二府新墾田四十餘頃，請三年後起科；

translations.literal: In the two prefectures of Nanchang and Ruizhou, more than forty qing of newly reclaimed land—I request that tax collection begin after three years;
translations.idiomatic: For more than forty qing of newly reclaimed land in Nanchang and Ruizhou prefectures, I ask that taxation begin only after three years;

sentences.zh: 未墾二千餘頃，請與豁除。」

translations.literal: for more than two thousand qing not yet reclaimed, I request total remission."
translations.idiomatic: and for more than two thousand qing still unreclaimed, I ask for complete exemption."

sentences.zh: 上允其請。

translations.literal: The sovereign granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his request.

sentences.zh: 十五年，加兵部尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was given the titular rank of Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 15, he was given the titular rank of Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十八年，擢江西總督。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was promoted to governor-general of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 18, he was promoted to governor-general of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，右布政使王庭疏請減南昌府屬浮糧，下朝璘議。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi, Right Provincial Admin Commissioner Wang Ting submitted a memorial requesting reduction of excess grain quotas under Nanchang prefecture; the matter was referred to Chaolin for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 2, Right Provincial Admin Commissioner Wang Ting petitioned to reduce inflated grain levies under Nanchang prefecture, and the case was sent to Chaolin for recommendation.

sentences.zh: 朝璘疏言：「江西重賦，自陳友諒始，明世因之。

translations.literal: Chaolin memorialized: "Jiangxi's heavy taxation began with Chen Youliang; the Ming dynasty perpetuated it.
translations.idiomatic: Chaolin memorialized: "Jiangxi's heavy tax burden began under Chen Youliang and was carried on through the Ming.

sentences.zh: 前巡撫蔡士英請減袁、瑞二府賦額，未及南昌。

translations.literal: The former governor Cai Shiying requested reduction of tax quotas for Yuan and Rui prefectures but did not reach Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: The former governor Cai Shiying had sought reductions for Yuan and Rui prefectures but had not addressed Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 南昌諸州縣，惟武寧為友諒鄉里，賦額循元、宋之舊。

translations.literal: Among Nanchang's prefectures and counties, only Wuning, Chen Youliang's homeland, had tax quotas following Yuan and Song precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Of Nanchang's subordinate prefectures and counties, only Wuning, Chen Youliang's home district, still followed Yuan and Song tax levels.

sentences.zh: 他六縣一州，請敕部核減。」

translations.literal: The other six counties and one subprefecture—I request an imperial order to the ministry to verify and reduce them."
translations.idiomatic: For the other six counties and one subprefecture, I ask that the ministry be ordered to review and reduce their quotas."

sentences.zh: 戶部覈上南昌府屬浮糧銀十二萬五千有奇、米十四萬九千有奇，上命悉蠲之。

translations.literal: The Board of Revenue verified and reported excess grain silver of more than 125,000 taels and rice of more than 149,000 shi under Nanchang prefecture; the sovereign ordered all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Revenue verified and reported more than 125,000 taels of excess grain silver and more than 149,000 shi of rice under Nanchang prefecture, and the emperor ordered all remitted.

sentences.zh: 三年，朝璘疏言：「吉安舊食粵鹽，遠且阻，請改食淮鹽。」

translations.literal: In the third year Chaolin memorialized: "Ji'an formerly consumed Guangdong salt, which was distant and difficult; I request changing to Huai salt."
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 3, Chaolin memorialized: "Ji'an has long used Guangdong salt, which is distant and hard to supply; I ask that it be switched to Huai salt."

sentences.zh: 下所司從之。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the responsible offices, which approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was referred to the responsible offices and approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，以江西總督省入江南，解任。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, because the Jiangxi governor-generalship was merged into Jiangnan, he was relieved of office.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 4, when the Jiangxi governor-generalship was absorbed into Jiangnan, he was relieved of duty.

sentences.zh: 五年，授福建總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed governor-general of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 5, he was appointed governor-general of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 六年，以老疾乞休。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, citing age and illness, he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 6, citing age and illness, he asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 越十餘年，卒。

translations.literal: More than ten years later, he died.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten years later, he died.

sentences.zh: 金礪，遼東人。

translations.literal: Jin Li was a native of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Li was from Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 明武進士，為鎮武堡都司。

translations.literal: A Ming jinshi of the military track, he served as brigade commander of Zhenwu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: A Ming military jinshi, he served as brigade commander of Zhenwu Fort.

sentences.zh: 初降，授甲喇額真，予世職三等副將。

translations.literal: Upon first surrender he was appointed Jalan Ejen and granted the hereditary rank of third-class deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: When he first surrendered, he was made Jalan Ejen and granted the hereditary rank of third-class deputy general.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，始設六部，以礪為兵部承政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong the Six Ministries were first established, and Li was made chief minister of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong year 5, when the Six Ministries were first established, Li was appointed chief minister of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 六年，上閱兵，與玉和等並賜鞍馬。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the sovereign reviewed the troops, he and Yuhe and others were together granted saddled horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong year 6, when the emperor reviewed the troops, he and Yuhe and others were together granted saddled horses.

sentences.zh: 調戶部承政。

translations.literal: He was transferred to chief minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to chief minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八年，考績，進二等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, upon merit evaluation, he was advanced to second-rank Meile Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong year 8, after a performance review, he was raised to second-rank Meile Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，從伐明，攻皮島，甲喇額真巴雅爾圖等先入敵陣，礪與副將高鴻中所將水師不進，前軍以是敗，坐論死，上以礪與鴻中來歸有功，特宥之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, following the campaign against Ming and attacking Pidao, Jalan Ejen Bayaritu and others entered the enemy line first; Li and Vice General Gao Hongzhong's naval force did not advance, and the vanguard was defeated on that account; he was liable to death by law, but the sovereign, because Li and Hongzhong had meritorious service upon coming over, specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year 2, during the campaign against the Ming and the attack on Pidao, Jalan Ejen Bayaritu and others broke into the enemy line first, while Li and the naval force under Vice General Gao Hongzhong failed to advance; the vanguard was routed, and Li was sentenced to death, but the emperor, noting that Li and Hongzhong had merited favor when they defected, specially pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 四年，漢軍旗制定，礪隸鑲紅旗，復為甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the Han Army Banners were established, Li was assigned to the Bordered Red Banner and again made Jalan Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year 4, when the Han Army Banners were organized, Li was assigned to the Bordered Red Banner and again made Jalan Ejen.

sentences.zh: 五年，授吏部參政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Vice Minister of the Board of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year 5, he was appointed Vice Minister of the Board of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢固山額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Gushan Ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year 6, he was promoted to Gushan Ejen.

sentences.zh: 迭克松山、塔山、前屯衛、中後所，授世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He successively captured Songshan, Tashan, Qiantunwei, and Zhonghousuo, and was granted the hereditary rank of third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: He successively captured Songshan, Tashan, Qiantunwei, and Zhonghousuo, and was granted the hereditary rank of third-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，五月，與梅勒額真李率泰安集天津亂民；

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, following the entry into the Pass, in the fifth month he and Meile Ejen Li Shuaitai pacified the unruly populace at Tianjin;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi, after entering the Pass, in the fifth month he and Meile Ejen Li Shuaitai pacified the unruly populace at Tianjin;

sentences.zh: 六月，復與固山額真葉臣宣撫山西。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he again joined Gushan Ejen Yechen in pacifying and reassuring Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he again joined Gushan Ejen Yechen in pacifying and reassuring Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 時李自成西遁，其將陳永福猶據太原，礪與葉臣潛往覘焉，城兵驟出，礪擊敗之，督本旗兵發砲克其城。

translations.literal: At the time Li Zicheng had fled west; his general Chen Yongfu still held Taiyuan. Li and Yechen secretly went to reconnoiter; garrison troops suddenly sallied forth; Li defeated them, supervised his banner troops in firing artillery, and captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng had already fled west, but his general Chen Yongfu still held Taiyuan; Li and Yechen went secretly to reconnoiter, and when garrison troops suddenly sallied out, Li routed them, directed his banner troops in bombarding the city, and took it.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜白金四百兩，進世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was granted four hundred taels of white silver and advanced in hereditary rank to second-rank Jalan Zhangjing.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from campaign, he received four hundred taels of silver and was raised in hereditary rank to second-rank Jalan Zhangjing.

sentences.zh: 二年，從順承郡王勒克德渾徵湖廣，明將馬進忠降复叛，礪與固山額真劉之源擊進忠武昌，奪戰艦六十餘，遂下湖南，戰衡州，斬明將黃朝宣；

translations.literal: In the second year, following Prince Shuncheng Lekdehun in campaigning against Huguang, Ming general Ma Jinzhong surrendered and then rebelled again; Li and Gushan Ejen Liu Zhiyuan attacked Jinzhong at Wuchang, seized more than sixty warships, then descended into Hunan, fought at Hengzhou, and beheaded Ming general Huang Chaoxuan;
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 2, following Prince Shuncheng Lekdehun against Huguang, the Ming general Ma Jinzhong surrendered and then rebelled again; Li and Gushan Ejen Liu Zhiyuan attacked Jinzhong at Wuchang, captured more than sixty warships, then pushed into Hunan, fought at Hengzhou, and beheaded the Ming general Huang Chaoxuan;

sentences.zh: 复戰長沙，斬明將楊國棟。

translations.literal: He again fought at Changsha and beheaded Ming general Yang Guodong.
translations.idiomatic: He fought again at Changsha and beheaded the Ming general Yang Guodong.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜黃金二十兩、白金四百兩，進世職一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was granted twenty taels of gold and four hundred taels of white silver, and advanced in hereditary rank to first-rank Adaha Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from campaign, he received twenty taels of gold and four hundred taels of silver, and was raised in hereditary rank to first-rank Adaha Hafan.

sentences.zh: 六月，授平南將軍，鎮浙江。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was appointed Pacification General of the South and garrisoned Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was appointed Pacification General of the South and posted to garrison Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Upon a grace edict he was granted Toosara Hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Upon a grace edict he was granted Toosara Hafan.

sentences.zh: 明魯王以海及其臣阮進、張名振屯舟山，礪與梅勒額真吳汝玠等率兵自寧波出定海，會總督陳錦破獲進於橫洋，遂克舟山，名振擁以海出走。

translations.literal: Ming Prince Lu Yihai and his ministers Ruan Jin and Zhang Mingzhen were encamped at Zhoushan; Li and Meile Ejen Wu Rujie and others led troops from Ningbo out through Dinghai, joined Governor Chen Jin in defeating and capturing Jin at Hengyang, then captured Zhoushan; Mingzhen escorted Yihai in flight.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Lu, Yihai, and his ministers Ruan Jin and Zhang Mingzhen were encamped at Zhoushan; Li and Meile Ejen Wu Rujie and others led troops from Ningbo through Dinghai, joined Governor Chen Jin in defeating and capturing Jin at Hengyang, then took Zhoushan, while Mingzhen fled with Yihai.

sentences.zh: 九年，鄭成功攻漳州，命礪帥師赴援，至泉州，成功退屯江東橋。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Zheng Chenggong attacked Zhangzhou; Li was ordered to command troops to relieve it; arriving at Quanzhou, Chenggong withdrew and encamped at Jiangdong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 9, when Zheng Chenggong attacked Zhangzhou, Li was ordered to lead relief troops; reaching Quanzhou, he found Chenggong had withdrawn to Jiangdong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 礪自長泰進屯漳州城北，分兵萬松關為犄角，七戰皆勝，漳州圍解，海澄、南靖、漳浦諸縣悉定。

translations.literal: Li advanced from Changtai and encamped north of Zhangzhou city, divided troops at Wansong Pass as a supporting force, won all seven engagements, lifted the siege of Zhangzhou, and pacified Haicheng, Nanjing, Zhangpu, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Li advanced from Changtai and encamped north of Zhangzhou, detached troops at Wansong Pass as a supporting wing, won all seven battles, lifted the siege of Zhangzhou, and pacified Haicheng, Nanjing, Zhangpu, and the other counties.

sentences.zh: 敘功，遇恩詔，進一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In recognition of merit, upon a grace edict he was advanced to first-rank Ashan-i Janggin Hafan with Toosara Hafan additionally.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements, and upon a grace edict, he was raised to first-rank Ashan-i Janggin Hafan with Toosara Hafan additionally.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授陝西四川總督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 11, he was appointed governor-general of Shaanxi and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十三年，引年乞休，加太子太保致仕。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he cited age in requesting retirement and was granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent upon retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year 13, citing his years, he asked to retire and was granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent upon leaving office.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi year 1.

sentences.zh: 論曰：養性、廷柱先世本滿洲，懷舊來歸，申以婚媾。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Yangxing and Tingzhu were originally Manchu in ancestry; cherishing old ties they came over, and marriage alliances were extended to them.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say Yangxing and Tingzhu were of Manchu descent; drawn by old ties they returned, and marriage alliances were granted them.

sentences.zh: 永芳歸附最先，思忠為遼左右族，皆蒙寵遇，各有賢子，振其家聲。

translations.literal: Yongfang was the earliest to submit; Sizhong was of a leading Liaodong clan—all received imperial favor, each had worthy sons, and restored their family reputations.
translations.idiomatic: Yongfang was the first to defect; Sizhong came from a leading Liaodong clan; all received imperial favor, and each had worthy sons who restored their family standing.

sentences.zh: 光遠初佐養性，後與廷柱分將漢軍，罷而復起。

translations.literal: Guangyuan at first assisted Yangxing; later he and Tingzhu separately commanded Han Army troops, was dismissed and then restored.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyuan first served under Yangxing; later he and Tingzhu separately commanded Han Army forces, and though dismissed, he was restored to office.

sentences.zh: 玉和戰死。

translations.literal: Yuhe died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Yuhe fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 同時諸降將有績效，賞延於世，或其子顯者，得以類從。

translations.literal: Contemporary surrendered generals who had achievements had rewards extending to posterity; or if their sons were eminent, they could be grouped by category and included.
translations.idiomatic: Other defecting generals of the time who had served well received rewards extending to their heirs; or if their sons were distinguished, they could be grouped here by kind.

sentences.zh: 後先奔走，才亦盛矣。

translations.literal: Running to and fro in succession, talent was indeed abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Serving one after another in urgent duty, their talent was truly abundant.
